pokedexEntries.rb: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

pokedexEntries.ye: This POKéMON flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.

pokedexEntries.go: Its well-developed chest muscles make it strong enough to whip up a gusty windstorm with just a few flaps.

pokedexEntries.si: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

pokedexEntries.cr: Its outstanding vision allows it to spot splashing MAGIKARP, even while flying at 3300 feet.

pokedexEntries.rs: This POKéMON has a dazzling plumage of beautifully glossy feathers. Many TRAINERS are captivated by the striking beauty of the feathers on its head, compelling them to choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.fr: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.

pokedexEntries.lg: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

pokedexEntries.em: This POKéMON has gorgeous, glossy feathers. Many TRAINERS are so captivated by the beautiful feathers on its head that they choose PIDGEOT as their POKéMON.

pokedexEntries.dpp: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.
